purpose: Acquire point-in-time Copper causal context independently of replay outcomes.

source_classes.name: industry_primary_or_specialist
targets: weekly supply/demand synthesis with source attribution

China July unwrought copper imports down 11.5% YoY and concentrate imports weaker
LME inventories +17,450t; disappointing China data versus tight concentrates/smelters

admission_rules: Persist publication/first-seen timestamp and never expose a record before it.
Prefer event facts over price-recap headlines.
Run every acquired record through integrity audit and News Intelligence before Market Brain.
Do not infer missing historical timestamps.
Do not use replay outcomes to select or label news.
Keep source text out of the repository when copyright/licensing does not permit storage; retain normalized event facts, timestamp, source, URL and provenance.
